verdict.rationale: Composio documents a large catalog (1000+/1500+ toolkits) and built-in discovery mechanisms like COMPOSIO_SEARCH_TOOLS meta-tool and agent-based task search (docs-30, docs-35, docs-16), letting agents find tools by capability at runtime. However, there is no clear evidence of a developer-facing browsable registry/catalog UI for searching tools by capability *before* wiring them in, distinct from runtime agent discovery. Missing for 10: a dedicated searchable catalog/registry page or API for pre-integration browsing, independent hands-on confirmation of search-by-capability accuracy.
